title: Cost fuse: MAX_TOOL_CALLS_PER_TURN default 60; daily token cap per space from UsageRecord
description: Evidence: pi-runtime.ts:84-90 unset → 0 = unlimited; UsageRecord written at executor.ts:3787, never read; Grok Bot burned a $300/week plan in a day. Do: (1) maxToolCallsPerTurn returns 60 when unset (0 only when explicitly 0/none); (2) env RAKAZO_DAILY_TOKEN_CAP (default 2_000_000): before starting a run, sum today's input+output tokens for the space; if over cap, fail the run with a clear user-facing message and post a message_user beat; keep the check in one small module (packages/adapters/src/spend-cap.ts) called from the executor run start — minimal executor surgery; tests. AC: adapters tests green incl. cap-exceeded case; a manual run with RAKAZO_DAILY_TOKEN_CAP=1 refuses with the message.
